rundown: Bulldogs beat Wildcats 101-61 at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, NV in front of 2,360. Bulldogs led 58-31 at half-time and never looked back. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 82%).
Leading the way — Bulldogs: Massamba Diop 18 pts; Xaivian Lee 11 ast, 9 reb. Wildcats: Dez Lindsay 16 pts; Jaylen Alexander 4 ast; Pape N'Diaye 5 reb.
Where Bulldogs won it: they shot 53% to 33%, shot 39% from three to 23% and won the boards 48-30.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Bulldogs closed as 14.5-point favorites and covered by 25.5; the total closed at 157.5 and they combined for 162, over by 4.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 25, 12:29 AM ET. It had Bulldogs 84% and Wildcats 16%, projecting Bulldogs 83.9 – Wildcats 72.9 (156.8 total, Bulldogs by 11).

Final: Bulldogs 101 – Wildcats 61. Right winner: it had Bulldogs at 84%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Bulldogs came in with a 12% above average attack and a 10% stingier than average defense (3-1, 85.3 scored and 70.8 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 178 and 178 games of evidence. Projected to score 83.9, they scored 101 (+17.1 points, 20% over); projected to allow 72.9, they allowed 61 (−11.9 points, 16% under).

Wildcats came in with a 3% above average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (3-2, 81.2 scored and 70.6 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 186 and 185 games of evidence. Projected to score 72.9, they scored 61 (−11.9 points, 16% under); projected to allow 83.9, they allowed 101 (+17.1 points, 20% over).

The bigger miss was Bulldogs' scoring (+17.1 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 162 against 156.8 projected (+5.2), about the 64th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

Margin: Bulldogs by 40 against Bulldogs by 11 projected, about the 1st percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±11).

An outlier: the simulations had a result this far off less than about 5% of the time, which usually means an input was wrong or missing, not just bad luck.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Wildcats ×1.00, Bulldogs ×1.02. It favored Bulldogs, who did beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
KSU ML (+850) at +850: the algo gave it 10% vs 10% fair (+0.3 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 10%). GONZ ML (-1450) at -1450: the algo gave it 90% vs 90% fair (-0.3 pts) — won (+0.1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 90%). KSU +14.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+0.7 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. GONZ -14.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-0.7 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. OVER 157.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (-0.1 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. UNDER 157.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0.1 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (DraftKings): spread: 71% of bets on Bulldogs, 54% of the money — Bulldogs covered; total: 52% of bets on the over, 24% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 86% of bets on Bulldogs, 26% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Bulldogs, who won and covered.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.010 of the raw projection. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1103 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.978 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Bulldogs attack ×1.021, defense ×0.992 (4 games); Wildcats attack ×1.011, defense ×1.006 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 29 points), no bet.
